BrowserAgent.description: Web automation and browser interactions for navigating pages, filling forms, and extracting data
capabilities: go_back - Go back in browser history
click - Click elements by their index
input - Input text into form fields
upload_file - Upload files to file inputs
find_text - Scroll to specific text on page
send_keys - Send special keys (Enter, Escape, etc.)
extract - Extract data from webpages using LLM
screenshot - Request a screenshot in your next browser state for visual confirmation

TerminalAgent.description: Command-line execution and system operations using PowerShell or CMD
capabilities: Cannot do File Operations and File type conversions

FileSystemAgent.description: Complete file and directory management including reading, writing, and converting documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD)
capabilities: Can create PDFs, DOCX, TXT, HTML, MD files - can be empty or contains the content from other agents like ResearchAgent
Move, rename, and copy files or repositories
Search for files using patterns and explore directory trees

RAGAgent.description: Knowledge retrieval from indexed documents using vector search with source citations

ResearchAgent.description: Web search and information gathering from the internet
capabilities: Cannot do file creation and file writing

IntegratorAgent.description: Integration with external services like Gmail, Google Drive, and Calendar via MCP
capabilities: Google Drive operations (upload, download, list files)
Google Calendar operations (create, list, update events)
